hero.sub: One album where all your guests share their photos in real time. No app to install: just scan a QR code.

how.title: Ready in a minute, simple for everyone
how.sub: You create the album. Your guests do the rest.

s1.title: Create your album
s1.text: Pick the occasion, name your album and set the date. It takes less than a minute.

s2.title: Share the QR code
s2.text: Show it on the tables, send the link or print it. Guests scan it with their phone.

s3.title: Guests upload their photos
s3.text: From the browser, no app and no sign-up: they take or pick a photo and send it.

s4.title: Relive the memories
s4.text: Photos land in the album and play live on the big screen as a slideshow.

how.qrPhotoCaption: A card on the table: guests scan the QR code and share their photos in the album.

features.title: Everything you need, nothing complicated
features.sub: Tools built to enjoy the event, not to complicate it.

qr.title: QR code and link
qr.text: A dedicated QR code and link for your album, to share however you like.

guests.title: Unlimited guests
guests.text: No limit on how many people can take part.

noApp.title: No app
noApp.text: It works in the phone’s browser: no download, no account for guests.

slideshow.title: Live slideshow
slideshow.text: Photos reach the big screen as they are taken.

booth.title: Guest photos and videos
booth.text: Guests take or pick photos and videos on their phone: they land in your album, in original quality.

privacy.title: You decide what shows
privacy.text: Two switches pause guest uploads and choose whether photos go on the big screen. Only people with the QR code or link get in.

custom.title: Personalization
custom.text: Name, date, venue and occasion: the guest page is all about you.

poster.title: QR cards and posters
poster.text: Print the table card and the poster with your album’s QR (Full album).

languages.title: 4 languages
languages.text: Italian, English, French and Spanish, one tap away.

benefits.title: The best photos are on your guests’ phones

b1.title: Everything in one place
b1.text: No more photos scattered across chats, groups and camera rolls: every shot goes to the same album.

b2.title: Zero effort for guests
b2.text: Scan, shoot, send. It works even for people who don’t love technology.

b3.title: A memory that lives in real time
b3.text: The slideshow puts photos on the big screen during the event, not weeks later.

b4.title: For every occasion
b4.text: Wedding, birthday, christening or any other event: same simplicity.

whatsapp.title: A group is not an album
whatsapp.sub: WhatsApp was made for chatting. MIOLOVE ALBUM was made for collecting memories.

r5.b: Everything is already collected, in one place

pricing.title: Simple. One payment.
pricing.sub: Start with a 7-day free trial, no card. If you love the album, activate it once and that’s it.

q1.q: Do I need to install an app?
q1.a: No. You manage the album in the browser and guests join from their phone’s browser by scanning the QR code.

q2.a: They scan the QR code or open the link, take or pick a photo and send it. No sign-up needed.

q3.a: You can still view the album and your photos are kept. New uploads stop until you activate the Full album.

q4.a: The trial is free. The Full album costs {price} (instead of {list}) once: it is not a subscription, it is not monthly and it is not per guest.

q5.q: Do I need a credit card to try it?
q5.a: No, the free trial does not require a credit card.

q6.q: Can I use it for events other than a wedding?
q6.a: Yes: wedding, birthday, christening or any other event. Pick the occasion when you create the album.

q7.a: Only people with the QR code or the link can take part. In the privacy settings you decide whether guests can send photos and whether to show them on the screen.

q8.a: Italian, English, French and Spanish, for you and for your guests.

cta.title: Create your album in a minute
cta.text: Try it free for 7 days. No credit card.
